_meta.facet: official weapon tables (decoded script.npk) joined to weapon names
sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TeeReckzi/OHMM/main/src/ohai/data/official/canonical_runtime/official-runtime-catalog.json (decoded from Once Human script.npk by OHMM, June-July 2026; tables: weapon_equipment 02548_58575b3c.pyc, gun_preset 02913_64d8a7df.pyc, gun_runtime 05509_bc5aafa8.pyc, bullet_runtime 02057_475e3761.pyc, weapon_blueprint_calibration 02106_493f74ec.pyc, calibration_global_config 04726_a1d887cb.pyc)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saitoh183/once-human-build-planner/main/data/weapons.json (OHDB mirror 2026-05-15; name <-> entity id via imageUrl .../images/entities/<equipOriginId>.png)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TeeReckzi/OHMM/main/docs/OFFICIAL_WEAPON_STAT_AUDIT.json (name -> official family match, used only for unmapped names)
https://github.com/0x91CEA55/OnceHuman in-game screenshots (validation of artLevel-5 x starRatio against 33 card readings)
_meta.howIdsMap: equipOriginId layout (observed): 10 FF V Q AA -> 10 = gun, FF = frame family (11 DE.50, 12 R500, 13 G17, 21 DBSG, 23 ACS12/AA12, 31 KV-SBR, 32 MPS5, 33 MPS7, 34 PDW90/P90, 36 TEC9, 41 SOCR, 42 KAM, 44 M416, 52 AWS.338, 53 HAMR, 55 SKS, 56 EBR-14/MK14, 62 MG4, 63 KVD, 73 bows...), V = variant within the frame, Q = equipQuality (1..4; see caveats), AA = artLevel 00..09. The OHDB entity id is the artLevel-1 row (…01); equipOriginIdBase = id - id%10 gives the artLevel-0 row and base+k the artLevel-k row. weaponEquipments[id] gives gunNo (runtime row: fire interval, reload, falloff, bullet) and blueprintNo (calibration rows: presetAttackRatio per strengthLv = star level, perkSlotCalibrationMax, base crit/critDmg/weakspot as E0100/E0200/E0300). gunPresetStats[id].gunPresetAttack is the base attack for that artLevel.
_meta.cardFormula: Displayed Tier V weapon card DMG = round(attackByArtLevel["5"] x starRatios[star-1]); verified on 33 in-game card readings (see data/test_vectors.json TV-CARD-*). OHDB lists attackByArtLevel["4"] as its "Tier 5" damage.
caveats: artLevel semantics: artLevel 5 is what the in-game Tier V card shows for a Lv.50 character; the catalog also has separate equipLevel=50 rows (ids ending 96) whose attack equals the artLevel-5 value, so artLevel is most likely a gear-LEVEL bracket (0..5 ~ levels 1/10/20/30/40/50), with artLevel 6-9 a capped placeholder (= 2 x artLevel 4). Whether Tier I-IV cards correspond to artLevel 0-3 or 1-4 is NOT verified.

equipQuality is NOT rarity: legendary Jaws/SOCR/Corrosion/Kumawink/KVD/M416 SA/KAM AG/Little Jaws/MG4 CM are quality 3 while legendary Bullseye/Compound Bow/Doombringer/Primal Rage/Outer Space/PDW90/G17 HO/TEC9 AR/Brahminy/SKS PF/Octopus are quality 4 (see rarityByEquipQuality); it may encode release batch / blueprint generation.

Alternate blueprints sharing the same gunNo (blueprintNo ending 91/96/99 etc.) carry different ladders: the ...91 variants have perkSlotCalibrationMax 0, crit rate/crit dmg 0 and a lower attack ladder (e.g. Jaws 13112391: 80/110/150/219/353 for artLevel 1-5) - probably trial/loaner/PvP-standardised copies, unverified. They are listed under altBlueprintsSameGun, never used for the main ladder.

Magazine size is NOT present in these tables (gunRuntimeStats has no clip field; preset baseAttrs D1100/D5100/O1100/O1000/O0500 do not match magazines). magazine is therefore null; magazineOhdbMirror is the OHDB-derived value from the lReDragol mirror for convenience.
Fire rate = 60 / autoTimeInterval; for burst weapons see burstBulletNum/burstBulletInterval; melee/bow rows may lack runtime data.
Calibration PERKS (e.g. Precision +25% Attack) are not in these tables and are not part of cardFormula.
Percent fields are plain percent numbers; times in seconds; ranges in metres.

Melee weapons (Crowbar, Kukri, Long Axe, Scourge, Stun Baton, Warning Sign, Frozen Northern Pike, The Fabled Masamune ...) have attack ladders but no gun runtime row (no fire interval/reload/falloff) in these tables.

altBlueprintsSameGun groups rows by their real blueprintNo: e.g. DE.50 - Jaws has 13112391 (equipQuality 4, artLevel 1-5 attack 80/110/150/219/353, no crit stats, 0 calibration slots, flat star ratios) and 13112396 (equipLevel 50, artLevel 1, attack 751 = the main ladder artLevel-5 value).
